title: Towards Adversarially Robust Multigraph Neural Networks for Financial Crime Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.31718v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial transaction networks are naturally represented as multigraphs, where repeated transactions between the same pair of accounts are modeled as distinct edges. Recently proposed multigraph neural network architectures leverage this structure explicitly to achieve a strong performance on anti-money laundering (AML) tasks. However, their robustness to adversaries that manipulate transaction structures to evade detection remains largely unexplored. We present the first scalable framework for structural attacks and adversarial training of multigraph neural networks using node-edge incidence matrices, adapting projected gradient descent and projected randomized block coordinate descent methods to optimize structural perturbations over such matrices. We further introduce a cycle-based regularizer that penalizes changes in the global counts of directed 2- and 3-cycles, providing a structural measure of attack plausibility. Experiments on

translated_title: 面向金融犯罪分析的对抗鲁棒多重图神经网络
translated_abstract: 金融交易网络天然可以用多重图来表示，其中同一对账户之间的重复交易被建模为不同的边。最近提出的多重图神经网络架构显式利用这种结构，在反洗钱（AML）任务上取得了强劲的性能。然而，它们对通过操纵交易结构来逃避检测的对抗者的鲁棒性在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们提出了首个基于节点-边关联矩阵的多重图神经网络结构攻击与对抗训练的可扩展框架，将投影梯度下降和投影随机块坐标下降方法适配于在此类矩阵上优化结构扰动。我们进一步引入了一种基于环的正则化器，对有向2-环和3-环的全局计数变化进行惩罚，提供了一种衡量攻击合理性的结构化指标。在……上的实验（摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个针对多重图神经网络的结构攻击与对抗训练可扩展框架，通过节点-边关联矩阵优化结构扰动，并引入基于有向环计数的正则化器衡量攻击合理性，从而提升反洗钱任务的对抗鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first scalable framework for structural attacks and adversarial training of multigraph neural networks using node-edge incidence matrices, introducing a cycle-based regularizer that penalizes changes in global directed 2- and 3-cycle counts to enhance adversarial robustness in anti-money laundering tasks.
